posts.caption:
Every run has holes in it. The trick is knowing exactly which ones before you're flipping through the back-issue bins.

Start a run on ComixCatalog and it keeps count for you: how many you own, the exact issues you're missing, and one button that puts every one of them on your wantlist. Already own a stack of a run? Mark it all at once, or select a range. Then print a checklist with yours already checked off. All free.

For the record, as of Oct 27: on League of Comic Geeks, the Missing Issues smart list is a Patron beta at $49 a year, and progress tracking is part of Pro.

The first 100 members are Founding Collectors: a numbered badge nobody after No. 100 can get, your name on the founders wall, and a lifetime membership. {{spots_left}}. Link in bio.
